name: WF-412 — Deal Underwriting, MAO & Offer Recommendation Controller

parameters.jsCode: const b=$json.body??$json; const leadId=String(b.leadId??'').trim(); const propertyId=String(b.propertyId??'').trim(); const dealId=String(b.dealId??'').trim(); return [{json:{...b,leadId,propertyId,dealId,receivedAt:new Date().toISOString()}}];

const input=$('Normalize Underwriting Request').first().json; const ctx=$json.context??$json; const p=ctx.property??{}; const d=ctx.deal??{}; const seller=ctx.seller??{}; const num=v=>Number.isFinite(Number(v))?Number(v):null; const arv=num(d.arv??p.arv??p.estimatedValue); const repairs=num(d.repairs??p.repairs); const purchasePrice=num(d.purchasePrice??d.offerAmount); const closingCosts=num(d.closingCosts??0)??0; const holdingCosts=num(d.holdingCosts??0)??0; const wholesaleCosts=num(d.wholesaleCosts??0)??0; const assignmentFeeTarget=num(d.assignmentFeeTarget??d.assignmentFee); const contingencyPct=num(d.contingencyPercent??10)??10; const repairContingency=repairs!==null?repairs*(contingencyPct/100):null; const totalCost=arv!==null&&purchasePrice!==null?(purchasePrice+closingCosts+holdingCosts+wholesaleCosts+(repairContingency??0)):null; const netSpread=arv!==null&&totalCost!==null?arv-totalCost:null; const conventionalMAO=arv!==null&&repairs!==null?arv*.70-repairs: null; const investorMarginPct=num(d.investorMarginPercent??15)??15; const marginMAO=arv!==null&&repairs!==null?arv*(1-investorMarginPct/100)-repairs-closingCosts-holdingCosts-wholesaleCosts-(repairContingency??0):null; const protectedMAO=num(d.protectedMAO??d.mao); const candidateMAOs=[conventionalMAO,marginMAO,protectedMAO].filter(v=>v!==null&&v>0); const recommendedMAO=candidateMAOs.length?Math.min(...candidateMAOs):null; const currentOffer=purchasePrice; const assignmentFee=assignmentFeeTarget??(arv!==null&&currentOffer!==null?Math.max(0,arv*.85-currentOffer):null); const projectedInvestorProfit=arv!==null&&recommendedMAO!==null?arv-recommendedMAO-repairs-closingCosts-holdingCosts-wholesaleCosts-(repairContingency??0):null; const offerGap=currentOffer!==null&&recommendedMAO!==null?recommendedMAO-currentOffer:null; const flags=[]; if(arv===null)flags.push('missing_arv'); if(repairs===null)flags.push('missing_repairs'); if(recommendedMAO===null)flags.push('mao_unavailable'); if(currentOffer!==null&&recommendedMAO!==null&&currentOffer>recommendedMAO)flags.push('offer_above_recommended_mao'); if(repairs!==null&&arv!==null&&repairs/arv>=.25)flags.push('extreme_repair_burden'); if(projectedInvestorProfit!==null&&projectedInvestorProfit<0)flags.push('negative_projected_profit'); const required=[arv,repairs,recommendedMAO].filter(v=>v!==null).length; const status=required===3?'underwriting_ready':required>=2?'partial_underwriting':'insufficient_data'; let recommendation='human_review'; if(status==='underwriting_ready'){ if(projectedInvestorProfit!==null&&projectedInvestorProfit>0&&currentOffer!==null&&currentOffer<=recommendedMAO)recommendation='proceed_to_offer'; else if(currentOffer!==null&&currentOffer>recommendedMAO)recommendation='reprice_or_negotiate'; else if(currentOffer===null)recommendation='prepare_offer'; else recommendation='human_review'; } const confidence=Math.round(Math.max(0,Math.min(100,(arv!==null?30:0)+(repairs!==null?25:0)+(recommendedMAO!==null?25:0)+(currentOffer!==null?10:0)+(ctx.compsVerified?10:0)))); const idempotencyKey='wf412:'+input.leadId+':'+input.propertyId+':'+input.dealId; return [{json:{...input,underwriting:{status,recommendation,arv,repairs,repairContingency,closingCosts,holdingCosts,wholesaleCosts,totalCost,conventionalMAO,marginMAO,protectedMAO,recommendedMAO,currentOffer,assignmentFee,projectedInvestorProfit,offerGap,confidenceScore:confidence,flags,assumptions:{conventionalMAOPercent:70,investorMarginPercent,repairContingencyPercent:contingencyPct}},seller:{sellerId:seller.id??null},idempotencyKey}}];

meta.notes: Underwriting and MAO calculations are deterministic scaffolding pending verified InsulaCRM fields, comp validation, repair-estimation provider, financing/closing assumptions, and production API contracts. Recommended MAO is a decision aid and not a guarantee of profitability.
